request.answer: After the Initial Term, this Agreement renews automatically for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives writen notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term. If Provider fails to meet this commitment in a calendar month, Customer will receive a service credit equal to 5% of the monthly fee for each full hour of unavailability, up to a maximum of 10% of the monthly fee for that month. These obligations continue for five (5) years after termination or expiration of this Agreement. Customer may assign this Agreement to any affiliate or acquirer without consent. Provider may not assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of Customer, except to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all of its assets. Any seperate attempt to assign is void.

request.instructions: The source is one version of an agreement. Each claim is a sentence taken from the other version of the same agreement. A claim is supported when the source states the same obligation, right, amount, rate, period, party and place, even if the wording, spelling, punctuation or number formatting differs. A claim is contradicted when the source states something different about any of those. Judge each claim against the passage of the source that covers the same subject.
